PDF Noise and Procedural Techniques - NVIDIA
Procedural Noise • Noise is an important part of many procedural textures • Used everywhere in production rendering • Procedural noise provides a controlled method of adding randomness to: - Color, texture - Bump map / displacement maps - Animation
